meta.notes: v0.6 greeting rules enforced: (1) T2+ greetings contain no strategy hints. (2) All tiers: no rank references, no championship status, no streak records. T1 greetings may still hint at strategy. 16 greetings updated in this pass (npc_015, 017, 019, 022, 023, 029, 036, 038, 039, 069, 074, 082, 092, 095, 098, 099). powerupInventory cleared each season and seeded by skill tree root node. Drops follow normal player reward system. v0.8: Flavor text system complete (Section 5.4.1 in design doc). Skill classification tags reclassified as implementation concern (Section 16.12 coding note). No NPC data changes this version. T2 and T3 greeting cleanup complete (v0.8): 18 greetings updated to remove strategy hints and streak records. v0.9: portraitId populated for all 99 NPCs. Direct assignment from 50-portrait pool (25 male, 25 female). Cultural tone matched to NPC name origin. Shared portraits kept across different tournament tiers where possible.

npcs.name: Benny Kowalski
npcs.greeting: Hey, no hard feelings whatever happens, yeah? I'm just happy to be here.

npcs.name: Darla Fitch
npcs.greeting: I always throw Rock. Always. Go ahead and try to stop me.

npcs.name: Tomás Reyes
npcs.greeting: I'll just do whatever you do. Seems fair, right?

npcs.name: Priya Nanda
npcs.greeting: The universe has a plan for both of us today. I trust mine completely.

npcs.name: Greg Mullen
npcs.greeting: Paper. Every single time. I've done the math and this is the correct answer.

npcs.name: Valentina Cruz
npcs.greeting: I find imitation is the most disorienting thing you can do to a person. Enjoy.

npcs.name: Dex Holbrook
npcs.greeting: Randomness is its own kind of strategy. Try to read chaos — I dare you.

npcs.name: Sunny Park
npcs.greeting: Good luck! Though I guess we're not really supposed to say that here. Good skill?

npcs.name: Marcus Tyde
npcs.greeting: Scissors. Committed. Unashamed. Come find me on the other side.

npcs.name: Flo Bassett
npcs.greeting: I let fate pick my throw before the match starts. After that, nothing you do matters.

npcs.name: Cecile Okafor
npcs.greeting: You look exactly like someone who thinks they have a plan. I respect that. Truly.

npcs.name: Rodrigo Vance
npcs.greeting: There is beauty in simplicity. I find the straightforward path is usually the right one.

npcs.name: Ingrid Solberg
npcs.greeting: I tend to hit my stride once things get going. Early rounds are just the warmup.

npcs.name: Kwame Asante
npcs.greeting: The universe provides clarity when you stop fighting it. I stopped fighting it a long time ago.

npcs.name: Nadia Volkov
npcs.greeting: I don't lose sleep before matches. I sleep very well, actually. That should concern you.

npcs.name: Jerome Pickett
npcs.greeting: I find that paying close attention is its own kind of skill. Most people never develop it.

npcs.name: Astrid Lund
npcs.greeting: I'm not in a hurry. Take all the time you need.

npcs.name: Fen Castillo
npcs.greeting: I have absolutely no idea what I'm doing and I'm at peace with that.

npcs.name: Petra Szabo
npcs.greeting: Human beings are wonderfully consistent. It is both our greatest strength and our greatest flaw.

npcs.name: Otto Brennan
npcs.greeting: Rock is the oldest throw. The primal throw. Paper is a cope.

npcs.name: Lena Mwangi
npcs.greeting: I'm perfectly calm right now. Ask me again in a few rounds.

npcs.name: Hiro Tanaka
npcs.greeting: I've never needed much time to feel comfortable in a match. Today won't be different.

npcs.name: Bex Calloway
npcs.greeting: I am genuinely curious how this plays out. I mean that without any condescension.

npcs.name: Saoirse Flynn
npcs.greeting: Scissors wins more than people think. Nobody respects Scissors. That's their mistake.

npcs.name: Winston Farrow
npcs.greeting: I am in a good place right now. Whether that continues is the only interesting question.

npcs.name: Cassandra Briggs
npcs.greeting: I like to think I am a good reader of situations. It has served me well so far.

npcs.name: Dmitri Voloshyn
npcs.greeting: You can feel it, can't you? That slight dread. Good. That's useful information for me.

npcs.name: Renata Bloom
npcs.greeting: I run hot. If you can stop me early, you've got a shot. Good luck with that.

npcs.name: Yusuf Al-Rashidi
npcs.greeting: I am not in a hurry. Take all the time you need.

npcs.name: Connie Marsh
npcs.greeting: I start calm. Whether I stay calm is entirely up to you.

npcs.name: Tunde Adeyemi
npcs.greeting: Every approach has its vulnerabilities. The real question is whether you can find mine.

npcs.name: Harriet Voss
npcs.greeting: Self-awareness is rarer than people think. I find most opponents know themselves less well than they believe.

npcs.name: Piotr Zielinski
npcs.greeting: I've been told I'm difficult to play when I'm angry. Let's find out together.

npcs.name: Jade Whitmore
npcs.greeting: I have made my peace with uncertainty. It is actually quite liberating once you get there.

npcs.name: Callum Reid
npcs.greeting: I tend to get sharper as a match goes on. The beginning is just orientation.

npcs.name: Amara Diallo
npcs.greeting: I find that quiet people absorb a lot more than they let on. I am a very quiet person.

npcs.name: Bo Sheridan
npcs.greeting: Look, sometimes it works out and sometimes it doesn't. Today feels like a works out day.

npcs.name: Siobhan Daly
npcs.greeting: I do not need to force anything. The right moment always presents itself.

npcs.name: Naoki Fujiwara
npcs.greeting: I take competition seriously. You will not find me underprepared for anything.

npcs.name: Patricia Ogle
npcs.greeting: Scissors forever. It stopped being a strategy years ago. Now it's just who I am.

npcs.name: Derek Holt
npcs.greeting: I keep it together right up until I don't. Buckle up.

npcs.name: Meiling Chow
npcs.greeting: I don't need luck. I need one win. Everything after that takes care of itself.

npcs.name: Rufus Crane
npcs.greeting: I have a very particular way of approaching things. Most people do not pick up on it until it is too late.

npcs.name: Fatou Sow
npcs.greeting: You will make a mistake. I am simply here to make sure it costs you everything.

npcs.name: Glen Ostrowski
npcs.greeting: Paper covers everything. Philosophically, I find that very satisfying.

npcs.name: Sylvia Drummond
npcs.greeting: I've been doing this long enough to know exactly how nervous you are right now.

npcs.name: Kweku Mensah
npcs.greeting: I don't peak early. Keep that in mind.

npcs.name: Rosamund Hale
npcs.greeting: Most people give everything away in the first two rounds. It's almost generous.

npcs.name: Aleksander Nowak
npcs.greeting: I have a very specific plan. You won't like where it ends.

npcs.name: Dara Fontaine
npcs.greeting: People underestimate me constantly. It genuinely never gets old.

npcs.name: Bjorn Halversen
npcs.greeting: You're going to make one mistake. I'm a patient person.

npcs.name: Irene Cho
npcs.greeting: I always finish what I start. That's not a boast. It's just a fact.

npcs.name: Tobias Wren
npcs.greeting: I know I have a reputation. Let's see if it's warranted today.

npcs.name: Priscilla Adaeze
npcs.greeting: I've read every match report filed in this tournament for the last four years. Including yours.

npcs.name: Garrett Sully
npcs.greeting: I've beaten people far more impressive than you. No offense.

npcs.name: Yuki Harada
npcs.greeting: Momentum is everything. Everything. I will not explain further.

npcs.name: Clement Ashby
npcs.greeting: Chaos has served me well. I see no reason to abandon it now.

npcs.name: Marisol Quiroga
npcs.greeting: This is what I do. It is not personal, but it will feel that way.

npcs.name: Patrick Lorne
npcs.greeting: My record speaks for itself. I prefer to let it do the talking.

npcs.name: Nneka Obi
npcs.greeting: I don't lose gracefully. Fair warning.

npcs.name: Hugo Renard
npcs.greeting: Discipline wins matches. I have been disciplined since I was seven years old.

npcs.name: Waverly Cross
npcs.greeting: People think my approach is reckless. I think their approach is boring.

npcs.name: Svetlana Morozova
npcs.greeting: I have been watching you. You have been watched longer than you think.

npcs.name: Colton Briggs
npcs.greeting: I've got a system. It took ten years to build. You won't break it today.

npcs.name: Seun Adebayo
npcs.greeting: Fourth tier. You made it this far. That's genuinely impressive. It ends here, though.

npcs.name: Delphine Marchetti
npcs.greeting: I've lost three Continental finals. That won't happen again.

npcs.name: Ramona Steele
npcs.greeting: I am very hard to rattle. People have tried. It does not go well for them.

npcs.name: Ezra Whitfield
npcs.greeting: Confidence is a skill. I've been working on mine for a long time.

npcs.name: Ingeborg Strand
npcs.greeting: I've put in the work that most people aren't willing to put in. That's not arrogance. That's just arithmetic.

npcs.name: Marcus Fenn
npcs.greeting: I know what you've heard about me. Half of it is true. You won't know which half until it's too late.

npcs.name: Vivienne Larue
npcs.greeting: World Championship. You're allowed to be nervous. Most people are.

npcs.name: Desmond Okafor
npcs.greeting: I don't remember the last time someone surprised me. I'm not being cruel — it's just been a while.

npcs.name: Cordelia Faust
npcs.greeting: Every match I've played this season has ended the same way. I see no reason today should be different.

npcs.name: Rajan Pillai
npcs.greeting: I don't find this stage intimidating anymore. That took a long time. I'm grateful for it.

npcs.name: Eleanor Vance
npcs.greeting: Don't mistake composure for lack of intent. I am extremely intentional.

npcs.name: Tariq Mansour
npcs.greeting: You've earned your place here. That's not nothing. Now let's see what it's worth.

npcs.name: Genevieve Holt
npcs.greeting: I respect anyone who makes it to this stage. I will show that respect by taking this completely seriously.

npcs.name: Lior Ben-David
npcs.greeting: This is my stage. I've been standing on it for three years. You're welcome to try and take it.

npcs.name: Audra Kline
npcs.greeting: I've beaten everyone in this bracket before. Some of them twice.

npcs.name: Pham Thi Lan
npcs.greeting: I have nothing to prove to anyone in this room. That is a very comfortable place to compete from.

npcs.name: Sterling Knox
npcs.greeting: I am not concerned. I want to be clear about that. I am completely unconcerned.

npcs.name: Chidinma Eze
npcs.greeting: I don't leave matches to chance if I can help it. I very rarely can't help it.

npcs.name: Fletcher Dane
npcs.greeting: I've had entire seasons where nothing could stop me. Today feels like one of those seasons.

npcs.name: Isolde Brandt
npcs.greeting: I've studied you more than you've studied yourself. That may sound arrogant. It isn't.

npcs.name: Calvin Mercer
npcs.greeting: I've played five hundred competitive matches. Every single one of them felt like this one.

npcs.name: Seren Griffiths
npcs.greeting: The World Championship is not like other tournaments. You'll feel that difference today.

npcs.name: Nikolai Baranov
npcs.greeting: I don't do anything I haven't done ten thousand times before. That is my entire advantage.

npcs.name: Portia Ames
npcs.greeting: I've never lost in this building. I plan to keep that record intact.

npcs.name: Jemima Cho
npcs.greeting: I like this sport because there's nowhere to hide. Nowhere for either of us.

npcs.name: Raphael Souza
npcs.greeting: I have been runner-up at this tournament twice. I am not interested in being runner-up again.

npcs.name: Laurel Finch
npcs.greeting: I'm one of the best in the world. I say that with no enjoyment. It's simply true.

npcs.name: Kwabena Asare
npcs.greeting: I want this more than you do. I say that with complete respect and absolute certainty.

npcs.name: Dorothea Crane
npcs.greeting: People expect a certain kind of player at this level. I enjoy not being that.

npcs.name: Solomon Bryce
npcs.greeting: The data on you is interesting. Not flattering, exactly. But interesting.

npcs.name: Miriam Castellanos
npcs.greeting: I have wanted to win every match I have ever played. That has never once changed.

npcs.name: Obinna Eze
npcs.greeting: Every player I've faced at this level has believed they could win. That belief has never been enough.

npcs.name: Adelaide Cross
npcs.greeting: I am going to win this tournament. I've known it since the bracket was announced.

npcs.name: Reginald Osei
npcs.greeting: I have earned my place at this level. So have you. Only one of us belongs in the next round.

npcs.name: Vera Ashmore
npcs.greeting: I worked my entire life to be able to compete at this level. You will not find me easy to beat.
